name: Last Night on Earth
source:
You haven't been a vampire long, but you've been one long enough to accidentally kill your first proper meal. When your sire made the pitch, he talked a lot about endless nights of hedonism and intrigue... and very little about the grim, bloody cost that makes it possible.

You dealt with it, and he wants to find out how. Step by bloody, gruesome step.

[From [url=https://bannerlessgames.itch.io/last-night-on-earth-vampire-jam]Itch.io[/url]]

This game is a parody of Vampire: The Masquerade.
translation:
你成为吸血鬼的时间并不长，但你已经足够长了，以至于不小心杀死了你的第一顿正餐。当你的父亲提出建议时，他谈论了很多关于享乐主义和阴谋的无尽夜晚……而很少谈论使这一切成为可能的残酷、血腥的代价。

你已经解决了，他想知道如何处理。一步一步血腥、可怕。

[来自[url=https://bannerlessgames.itch.io/last-night-on-earth-vampire-jam]Itch.io[/url]]

该游戏是对《吸血鬼：假面舞会》的模仿。
